title: Missing authorization on a TypeScript service operation
preconditions: authenticated or anonymous request reaches a state-changing handler
route parameter selects a protected object
dangerous_transitions: request reaches sensitive service operation without principal/resource/action policy check
sink_semantics: Express/Koa/Fastify route handlers and service methods
database writes, secret reads, and administrative operations
counterevidence: A verified authorization policy dominates the operation for every registered route and alias.
verification_recipe: Enumerate route registration, middleware ordering, aliases, and service entry points.
Test anonymous, low-privilege, owner, and cross-tenant principals.
